title: Additional eigenvalue control

required_source.result_applied: D5: ||p_Q||inf <= 5 sqrt(2e) e_5(M^T M)^(-1/10) for an actual original-coordinate cross block, no marginal condition

partner_source.result_applied: s_j(B+R)>=s_{j+k}(B)-s_{k+1}(R), compiled into an adaptive physical-core reserve envelope

new_claims.statement: For M_final=M0+L+R+T with rank L<=r and ||T||op<=delta, s_q(M_final)>=max_p[s_{q+r+p}(M0)-s_{p+1}(R)]-delta.
If s_N(M0)>=kappa and N>=r+q, then s_q(M_final)>=kappa-delta-||R||F/sqrt(N-r-q+1); the aggregate coefficient is sharp from this information.
For an actual original-coordinate cross block and q=5, positive reserve gap gamma implies ||p_Q||inf<=5 sqrt(2e)/gamma by the pinned D5 theorem, with arbitrary same-bank blocks and outside couplings.

exact_target_family: Two 64-coordinate banks with baseline cross 2I_64, any number of +2 spectators mixed with g1 into an arbitrary-eigenvalue packet of rank-one cross footprint, plus 63 further +2 to +3 eigenvalue replacements and any symmetric dense tail ||T||op<=1/4. The Frobenius reserve gap is at least 7/4-(1/2)sqrt(63/59), giving density cap 9.452645656349882; 64 untouched -2 directions keep the exact global target hypothesis.
unresolved_implication: Bare global s_3(A)>=1 still does not force a long original-coordinate cross/core reserve. Force such a positive adaptive reserve envelope in the no-pivot/N3 survivor or exit through an already-paid volume/hub/ridge/grouped-bank/pair/triple/Schur certificate.
